d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, ekdam danedar, soft aur tasty Matka Kulfi Kaise banae, bina koi powder chemical, uski recipe share kar raha hu, aap bhi try karna, bazaar se jyada tasty banegi!
Ingredients:
Doodh - full cream wala acha rahega - 1.5 Liter
Malai - 50-60g (3 tbsp)
Kesar - few strands
Lemon - 1/4 piece
Coconut - 1 tbsp grated, dry wala
Sugar - 120g
